features.title: Clean baseline: ./init.sh passes

features.title: RAG playground: two-step and agentic RAG over the campaign summary
features.user_visible_behavior: `uv run rag-playground` answers questions from data/rag/*.docx using local Ollama models; `--agentic` lets the model call search_campaign itself. Both show the chapters retrieved.
verification: Run `uv run rag-playground` and `uv run rag-playground --agentic` against the real document and check the retrieved chapters match the question.
evidence: 2026-11-10: real run, bge-m3 + PLAYGROUND_MODEL. 657 chunks embedded. Two-step: 'What was the Shattering?' retrieved 'History of Aeloria > The shattering'; 'Who is Salazar the Lavender?' retrieved Chapter 41. Agentic: a question spanning chapters 6-8 triggered 3 search_campaign calls; 'Who is Kallista?' triggered 1.
features.notes: Answers were not fact-checked against the story by a human. Not built yet: hybrid/keyword search, reranking, chunk overlap, an eval question set.

features.title: Pull requests into main are required and checked by CI
features.user_visible_behavior: main only changes through a pull request, and every pull request runs ./init.sh on GitHub Actions.
verification: Open a pull request and verify the 'checks' job runs ./init.sh and passes.
Verify `gh ruleset check main` lists pull_request and required_status_checks.
evidence: 2026-11-10: PR #1, CI run 42907492356: 'checks' job ran ./init.sh and passed in 26s.
2026-11-10: ruleset 26983810 updated; rules on main: deletion, non_fast_forward, pull_request, required_status_checks (context 'checks').
features.notes: Ruleset 'protect-main' (id 26983810) on GitHub; 0 required approvals because the repo has one contributor.

features.title: RAG playground searches in a LanceDB vector database, numpy as fallback
features.user_visible_behavior: `uv run rag-playground` searches a LanceDB table by default; `RAG_STORE=numpy` searches the same vectors in numpy. The startup line names the store. Both return the same chunks.
verification: Run the playground with RAG_STORE=lancedb and RAG_STORE=numpy and check the same sections are retrieved.
evidence: 2026-11-10: ./init.sh exit 0, pytest 110 passed (4 new, including a lancedb-vs-numpy order test).
2026-11-10: real index, 657 rows. Same top-5 chunks from both stores on 8 of 8 real questions, and on 200 of 200 chunk vectors used as queries. Table build 15 ms, search 8 ms.
features.notes: lancedb 0.41.0 on Python 3.14. No ANN index is created, so the search is exact. Not built: metadata filter by chapter (the table has a `section` column ready), hybrid keyword search, incremental adds.
